subject: history
concept: Understanding how geography (mountains, rivers, coastlines) affects where and how people live
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a coastal community scene to a mountain community scene and lists lifestyle differences
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a geographic feature to a way of life it supports (fishing near coast, farming in valley)
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described landscape feature might affect how people there live

misconception_flags: cannot connect a geographic feature to any specific effect on daily life or livelihood

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
